lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A primary vertical column of five high-luminance circular spots is located immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit. Subsequent columns maintain a vertical spacing of approximately 1.5 to 2 blob diameters, forming a rectangular grid that extends posteriorly along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows to form a coordinate-like grid; the high-luminance blobs are centered precisely at these intersections, particularly prominent in the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal carinal ridge originates above the superior margin of the gill slits and traverses the length of the visible flank, characterized by high-intensity pixel values on the dorsal edge and a sharp shadow gradient (low-intensity pixels) on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains approximately 15-20 high-luminance blobs, with higher spatial frequency and smaller diameter observed near the base and trailing margin, becoming more isolated toward the apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A sharp, V-shaped notch/indentation is visible on the posterior (trailing) edge of the left pectoral fin near its proximal attachment to the body.
other_distinctive_markers: Two remoras are visible as low-luminance, elongated silhouettes attached to the ventral surface posterior to the pectoral fin.
